settings.content: These settings appear across the whole site. Change them once here and every product page, the cart, and the Made to Order page update together.

settings.label: Standard crafting time
settings.info: Example: 7–10 business days. Shown on product pages, the cart, and the Made to Order page.

settings.label: Personalized or custom crafting time
settings.info: Shown when a product offers engraving or personalization.

settings.label: Made-to-order message
settings.default: This piece is made after you order it. Please allow approximately [LEAD_TIME] for crafting before shipment.
settings.info: [LEAD_TIME] is replaced automatically with the crafting time above (or the product's own crafting time, if set).

settings.label: Shipping time note
settings.default: Shipping time is separate and is calculated at checkout based on your address and shipping method.

settings.label: Show workshop availability message
settings.info: Shows on the homepage, Made to Order page, and product pages. Only turn on when the message is true this month.

settings.label: I confirm pieces are made in the United States
settings.info: Check only after confirming it is accurate. When unchecked, the site says "Handcrafted in Ed's workshop" instead of "Handcrafted in America".

settings.label: Location shown in footer (optional)
settings.info: City and state only, or leave blank. Do not list a home address.

settings.label: Accepting custom requests
settings.info: When off, the Custom Request page explains that requests are paused instead of showing the form. Also remove the page from the menu in Online Store > Navigation.

settings.label: Logo image (optional)
settings.info: Leave empty to use the built-in EDS WoodWorx wordmark and ring mark.

settings.label: Favicon
settings.info: Square image, at least 64 × 64 px. Use the ring maker's mark.

settings.label: Default social sharing image
settings.info: Used when a page has no image of its own. 1200 × 628 px recommended.

settings.content: Colors are fixed in the theme to protect readability and contrast. Fonts can be changed, but keep a classic serif for headings and a plain sans-serif for body text.

settings.label: Show gift note box in cart
settings.info: Saved as the order note so it appears on the order in your admin.

settings.label: Free shipping note (optional)
settings.info: Example: Free shipping on orders over $[AMOUNT]. Leave blank if you don't offer it.
